_note: Wave 2 of the jerseyxie import, 2026-09-27 (catalog/sources/jerseyxie/wave2.json). The owner gave full approval to import more products at the same prices and confirmed this wave in the conversation. Each row's albums were checked photo by photo against the club's released 26/27 kits; the studio photos were compared with the supplier's (logos, sponsors, crests, colours; re-rendered where the renderer changed a detail). Products were created as DRAFT with productSet, read back, then set ACTIVE and published to the Online Store. English and Arabic texts registered; adult and kids versions linked with sportwear.counterpart.
